name: Fernchant Verdant Sap
description: A slow-curing sap with restorative woodland charge.
specialEffects: Used in crooks, staves, and living wood implements.

steps: Refine raw stock for Fernchant Verdant Sap under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Fernchant Refinery protocol before storage.
